title: 'Eto na. Happy?': Remulla reimburses Isabela vice mayor for drug test
summary: Interior Secretary Jonvic Remulla has reimbursed Reina Mercedes, Isabela Vice Mayor Harold Respicio P28,011 for the drug test he took after accepting the secretary’s challenge.
